```python
# netnomos/radix.py
"""Mixed-radix universe enumeration (slot-major flattened cells, lex order)."""
import numpy as np

class RadixSpace:
    def __init__(self, radices, domains):
        self.radices = list(radices)
        self.domains = [np.asarray(d, dtype=np.int64) for d in domains]
        C = len(radices)
        strides = [1]*C
        for i in range(C-2, -1, -1):
            strides[i] = strides[i+1]*radices[i+1]
        self.strides = strides
        self.size = strides[0]*radices[0]
        self.positions = np.arange(self.size, dtype=np.int64)
        self._ranks = {}
    def ranks(self, cell):
        r = self._ranks.get(cell)
        if r is None:
            r = (self.positions // self.strides[cell]) % self.radices[cell]
            r = r.astype(np.int32, copy=False)  # hmm int32 ok if radix <= 65536 fits
            self._ranks[cell] = r
        return r
    def values(self, cell):
        return self.domains[cell][self.ranks(cell)]
    def all_cells(self):
        return {i: self.values(i) for i in range(len(self.radices))}
```
